observation_indicators.observable_fil: May kontrol sa apat na uri, malinaw na responsable at walang sariling pagbabago sa clinical o engineering na proseso.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Includes all four types, appropriate owners and no unauthorized clinical or engineering changes.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Mask lamang ang sagot o binabago ang isolation arrangement nang walang gabay.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Relies only on a mask or changes isolation arrangements without guidance.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Magkakaugnay ang apat na kontrol at malinaw ang dapat ipasuri nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Links all four controls and identifies what needs review without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May maraming kontrol pero kailangang paalalahanang magtalaga ng responsable.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Suggests several controls but needs a prompt to assign owners.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Mask lamang ang sagot o binabago ang isolation arrangement nang walang gabay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Relies only on a mask or changes isolation arrangements without guidance.
